podcast.body: The lead single from the 1984 album "Tonight," benefiting from the lingering success of "Let's Dance." This bopping love song, a pastiche of Bowie's 80s sound, became another top 10 hit for Bowie on both sides of the Atlantic. It was supported by a 20-minute short film/music video directed by British author Julian Temple, with a shortened version airing on MTV. "Nonetheless, Blue Jean, a pastiche of Bowie's 80s sound in the form of a bopping love song, became another top 10 hit for Bowie on both sides of the Atlantic."

podcast.body: This "glossy 84 single" became a number eight hit in November, continuing the hot streak David Bowie had initiated with his "Let's Dance" LP the previous year. Bowie, who had just turned 37, demonstrated his enduring ability to produce commercially successful pop music.
